title: Verify valid custom field definition can be created

steps.action: Send POST /rulesengine/fields with parameterized valid CreateFieldDefinitionRequest.
steps.expected: Response is 201 Created; response includes generated id, tenant_id, field_code, display_name, data_type, scope, is_active=false, is_standard=false, and audit fields.

title: Verify field_code rejects invalid snake_case values

steps.action: Send POST /fields using parameterized invalid field_code variants: uppercase, starts with digit, contains hyphen, contains space, too short, or too long.
steps.expected: Each request returns 400 Bad Request with INVALID_FIELD_CODE or field-level  detail.

title: Verify Enum field requires allowed_values

steps.action: Send POST /fields with data_type=Enum and allowed_values omitted or null.
steps.expected: Response is 400 Bad Request with ENUM_REQUIRES_ALLOWED_VALUES or equivalent  detail.

title: Verify Enum field rejects invalid allowed_values JSON

steps.action: Send POST /fields with data_type=Enum and allowed_values={{invalidJsonOrNonArrayValue}}.
steps.expected: Response is 400 Bad Request with INVALID_ALLOWED_VALUES_JSON or equivalent  detail.

title: Verify field accepts valid _regex

steps.action: Send POST /fields with _regex={{validRegexPattern}}.
steps.expected: Response is 201 Created and response stores _regex value.

title: Verify field rejects invalid _regex

steps.action: Send POST /fields or PUT /fields/{id}/ with _regex={{invalidRegexPattern}}.
steps.expected: Response is 400 Bad Request with INVALID__REGEX or descriptive  detail.

title: Verify duplicate field_code for same tenant returns 409

steps.action: Create field {{validSnakeCaseFieldCode}}, then create another field with same field_code in same tenant.
steps.expected: Second request returns 409 Conflict with DUPLICATE_FIELD_CODE; no duplicate field is created.

title: Verify GET fields excludes inactive by default

steps.action: Create field, activate one field, leave another inactive, then send GET /fields without includeInactive.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and includes active fields only; inactive field is excluded.

title: Verify GET fields includeInactive returns inactive and active fields

steps.action: Send GET /fields?includeInactive=true.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and includes both active and inactive non-deleted fields for the tenant.

title: Verify GET custom fields returns only non-standard fields

steps.action: Send GET /rulesengine/fields/custom.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and every returned item has is_standard=false.

title: Verify GET field by id returns full field projection

steps.action: Send GET /fields/{{fieldId}}.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and includes all documented field attributes including , scoping, entity link, is_active, created_at, and created_by.

title: Verify GET field by unknown id returns 404

steps.action: Send GET /fields/{{unknownOrCrossTenantFieldId}}.
steps.expected: Response is 404 Not Found and does not expose cross-tenant data.

title: Verify GET field by code returns matching field

steps.action: Send GET /fields/by-code/{{fieldCode}} for an existing field.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and field_code equals requested code.

title: Verify GET field by unknown code returns 404

steps.action: Send GET /fields/by-code/{{unknownFieldCode}}.
steps.expected: Response is 404 Not Found with FIELD_CODE_NOT_FOUND or equivalent detail.

title: Verify update field  rules succeeds

steps.action: Send PUT /fields/{{fieldId}}/ with parameterized is_required, default_value, allowed_values, or _regex per schema.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK; subsequent GET shows updated  settings; data_model_change_logs contains update entry.

title: Verify activate inactive field succeeds

steps.action: Send POST /fields/{{inactiveFieldId}}/activate.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK; subsequent GET shows is_active=true and change log is recorded.

title: Verify activating already active field is blocked

steps.action: Send POST /fields/{{activeFieldId}}/activate.
steps.expected: Response is 422 Unprocessable Entity with FIELD_ALREADY_ACTIVE or equivalent detail.

title: Verify deactivation impact check returns referencing rule codes

steps.action: Send GET /fields/{{fieldIdReferencedByActiveRule}}/impact.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and affected_rule_codes contains the expected parameterized rule code list; if no references exist, response returns an empty array with 200.

title: Verify deactivate active field succeeds after impact review

steps.action: After impact endpoint is reviewed, send POST /fields/{{activeFieldId}}/deactivate.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK; subsequent GET with includeInactive shows is_active=false and change log captures impact summary.

title: Verify deactivating already inactive field is blocked

steps.action: Send POST /fields/{{inactiveFieldId}}/deactivate.
steps.expected: Response is 422 Unprocessable Entity with FIELD_ALREADY_INACTIVE or equivalent detail.

title: Verify valid custom entity can be created

steps.action: Send POST /rulesengine/entities with valid parameterized entity request.
steps.expected: Response is 201 Created with generated id, entity_code, display_name, product/lob scope, is_active=false, and audit fields.

title: Verify entity_code rejects invalid snake_case values

steps.action: Send POST /entities using invalid entity_code variants from test data.
steps.expected: Each request returns 400 Bad Request with entity_code  detail.

title: Verify duplicate entity_code for same tenant returns 409

steps.action: Create entity {{entityCode}}, then create another entity with same code in same tenant.
steps.expected: Second request returns 409 Conflict with DUPLICATE_ENTITY_CODE; no duplicate entity is created.

title: Verify GET entities returns tenant-scoped entities

steps.action: Send GET /rulesengine/entities.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and includes only current tenant entities, excluding soft-deleted records.

title: Verify GET entity by id includes linked fields

steps.action: Create entity, create field linked by custom_entity_id, then send GET /entities/{{entityId}}.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and linked fields collection includes the parameterized field_code.

title: Verify entity activation succeeds when eligible

steps.action: Ensure entity has required linked field if implementation enforces it, then send POST /entities/{{inactiveEntityId}}/activate.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and subsequent GET shows is_active=true.

title: Verify entity deactivation succeeds from active state

steps.action: Send POST /entities/{{activeEntityId}}/deactivate.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and subsequent GET shows is_active=false.

title: Verify missing token returns 401 for field and entity endpoints

steps.action: Execute representative field and entity read/write endpoints without Authorization header.
steps.expected: Each request returns 401 Unauthorized and no mutation occurs.

title: Verify wrong role returns 403 for field and entity endpoints

steps.action: Call mutation endpoint with monitor-only token and read endpoint with manage-only or invalid scoped token as applicable to implementation.
steps.expected: Response is 403 Forbidden for insufficient policy; resource remains unchanged.

title: Verify all data model mutations create audit log entries

steps.action: Perform field create,  update, activate/deactivate, entity create, activate/deactivate and verify audit log through API/DB-approved observation path.
steps.expected: Each mutation has a corresponding change log with tenant_id, change_type, subject_id, subject_code, changed_by, changed_at, change_description, and affected_rule_codes where applicable.
